name: Source Medium Tracker for Contact Form 7
author: asynadak

sections.description:
Source Medium Tracker for Contact Form 7 allows you to track the source and medium of visitors who submit your Contact Form 7 forms. Starting from version 2.3, you can also send conversion events to Google Ads and Google Analytics upon form submission.

Features:

  • Source/Medium Tracking: Capture and store the utm_source and utm_medium parameters from your marketing campaigns.
  • Detailed Analytics: View reports of form submissions by source and medium within the WordPress admin area.
  • Dashboard Widget: Get quick stats on daily form submissions and view a customizable graph of submissions over time.
  • Google Ads Conversion Tracking: Automatically send conversion events to Google Ads when a form is submitted.
  • Google Analytics Integration: Send form submission events to Google Analytics 4 (GA4) using client-side or server-side tracking.
  • Easy Configuration: Set up and manage settings directly from the WordPress dashboard.

Benefits:

  • Optimize Marketing Efforts: Understand which campaigns and channels drive the most conversions.
  • Improve ROI: Allocate resources to the most effective marketing strategies.
  • Simplify Tracking: No need to manually add tracking codes to your forms.

License

This plugin is free software; you can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the GNU General Public License version 2 as published by the Free Software Foundation.

Additional Notes

Support and Documentation:

  • For detailed documentation and support, please visit our website.
  • If you find this plugin useful, please consider leaving a review.

Privacy Notice:

This plugin collects and stores data related to form submissions, including source and medium information. If you enable conversion tracking, data will be sent to third-party services like Google Ads and Google Analytics. Please ensure that you disclose this information to your users and comply with all applicable privacy laws and regulations.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin:
    • Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/source-medium-tracker-for-contact-form-7 directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the Plugin:
    • Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure Settings:
    • Go to Settings > CF7 Tracker Settings in your WordPress admin dashboard.
    • Enable conversion tracking and enter your Google Ads Conversion ID and Label, and your Google Analytics Measurement ID and API Secret if applicable.
  4. You’re All Set:
    • The plugin will now start tracking form submissions and sending conversion events.
sections.faq:
How do I enable conversion tracking?

Navigate to Settings > CF7 Tracker Settings in your WordPress admin area. Check the option to enable conversion tracking and fill in your Google Ads Conversion ID and Conversion Label, as well as your Google Analytics Measurement ID and API Secret if you plan to use server-side tracking.

Is this plugin compatible with all versions of Contact Form 7?

The plugin is compatible with Contact Form 7 version 5.0 and above. We recommend keeping both plugins updated to their latest versions for the best performance and security.

Does this plugin comply with GDPR and other privacy laws?

While the plugin minimizes data collection and provides options for anonymization, it’s your responsibility to ensure compliance with all relevant laws and regulations. Consider updating your privacy policy and obtaining user consent where necessary.

How can I view the form submission reports?

You can view detailed reports by navigating to CF7 Tracker in your WordPress admin menu. The reports include submission counts by source and medium, as well as conversion rates.

Can I customize the dashboard widget?

Yes, the dashboard widget allows you to adjust the date range for the submission graph. Simply select the desired dates, and the graph will update accordingly.
